items.title: 10.21 Activity series ya reaction data se redox reactions ki feasibility (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.21, printed page 238.

blocks.text: Activity series sab se zyada se sab se kam tak metals ki reactivity series hai; yeh single displacement reactions ke products tay karne mein istemal hoti hai, jin mein metal M1 solution mein doosre metal M2 ko be-dakhal karta hai agar M1 series mein ooncha ho. Series se hum faisla kar sakte hain ke reaction mumkin hai ya nahi: hum half-reactions ke potentials jama karte hain, aur agar cell potential musbat ho to reaction mumkin hai, manfi ho to nahi. Fe2+(aq) + 2e- se Fe(s), E = -0.44 V, aur Ag+(aq) + e- se Ag(s), E = +0.80 V, ke liye kul reaction Fe(s) + 2Ag+(aq) se Fe2+(aq) + 2Ag(s) ka E cell = 0.80 - (-0.44) = +1.24 V, musbat, to reaction mumkin hai. Ek aur misal: Al3+(aq) + 3e- se Al(s), E = -1.66 V, aur Ag+ + e- se Ag, +0.80 V; Al3+(aq) + Ag(s) se Al(s) + Ag+(aq) ke liye E cell = -1.66 - 0.80 = -2.46 V manfi hai, to reaction mumkin nahi.

blocks.caption: Series se feasibility
rows: haan: Fe Ag se ooncha hai
nahi: Ag Al se neecha hai

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne silver ka E standard '+0.080 V' chhapa hai; sahi +0.80 V hai (Fe + 2Ag+ ka +1.24 V bhi isi se banta hai). Doosri misal mein kitab ne Al3+ + Ag ke liye -1.66 + 0.080 = -0.86 V likha hai. Sahi E cell = E(Al3+/Al) - E(Ag+/Ag) = -1.66 - 0.80 = -2.46 V hai, kyunke Ag oxidise ho raha hai (Ag se Ag+ ka potential -0.80 V). Jawab manfi hi rehta hai, is liye reaction mumkin nahi.

blocks.prompt: Tarteeb K > Mg > Zn > Fe > Cu istemal karte hue batayein ke copper magnesium sulfate solution se react karta hai ya nahi aur zinc copper sulfate solution se, muadlon ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Copper magnesium se neeche hai, to use be-dakhal nahi kar sakta: koi reaction nahi. Zinc copper se ooncha hai, to use be-dakhal karta hai: Zn + CuSO4 se ZnSO4 + Cu, E cell = 0.34 - (-0.76) = +1.10 V ke saath.

items: Ooncha metal neeche wale ko solution se be-dakhal karta hai; half-cell potentials ka majmooa (reduction manfi oxidation) musbat ho to mumkin: Fe + 2Ag+ (+1.24 V) haan; Al3+ + Ag nahi.
